picks.editorial_note: A $100M national program to expand AI compute access and workforce training marks one of the largest federal investments in AI research infrastructure this year, with ripple effects across dozens of institutions.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: NIST's formal MOU with DOE under the White House-led Genesis Mission signals a coordinated federal push to embed AI across national science and technology strategy, a policy shift with long-term implications for how agencies fund and direct AI research.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: A $24.9M NSF grant to build a nationally accessible self-driving laboratory for metals discovery represents a major bet on autonomous, AI-driven experimentation reshaping materials science at scale.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's national Programmable Cloud Laboratory extends autonomous, AI-guided experimentation to advanced manufacturing, knitting together a shared research infrastructure that other institutions can plug into.
picks.title: Georgia Tech to Lead National Cloud Laboratory for Advanced Manufacturing and Materials

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $50M investment in two Materials Innovation Platforms adds substantial autonomous AI-driven research capacity in Texas and Wisconsin, part of a broader federal build-out of self-driving lab infrastructure.
picks.title: NSF stands up 2 Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M investment

picks.editorial_note: An agentic AI 'scientist' that can independently design, run, and interpret experiments is a genuine step toward autonomous scientific discovery, with DOE and SLAC backing signaling real institutional confidence in the approach.
picks.title: This AI scientist can run experiments. Self-driving labs coming next

picks.editorial_note: A $9.8M Navy contract for AI-enabled autonomous undersea systems shows academic-industry-defense collaboration translating directly into fielded military capability, an important marker of AI's expanding role in national security.
picks.title: Integer Technologies and Southern Miss Awarded $9.8M to Increase U.S. Navy Seabed Warfare Capabilities

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot's unicorn valuation, TUM's 23rd, is a concrete signal that university-spawned AI agent startups are achieving major commercial success, validating academic entrepreneurship pipelines in AI.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's DUNE collaboration integrating AI across neutrino detector operations shows machine learning becoming core infrastructure for flagship physics experiments, not just an auxiliary tool.
picks.title: DUNE uses AI to transform the future of neutrino research

picks.editorial_note: HKU's atomically thin in-memory search chip offers a genuinely novel hardware architecture that could bypass the von Neumann bottleneck limiting AI computing efficiency, a notable materials-to-computing breakthrough.
picks.title: HKU Engineering develops atomically thin “analogue in-memory search” chip to redefine AI computing limits with minimalist architecture - Press Releases - Media - HKU
